text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen— someone who could easily 
be called the strongest among Ikuno 
Dictus's generation right now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She learned self-management techniques 
from Ikuno Dictus and incorporated them 
into her own training. As a result, she 
achieved astonishing growth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Ikuno Dictus's growth also far 
surpasses that of an average Umamusume. 
Now, the two will clash in the Osaka Hai—!
